verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a real-time media transport and relay, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it bridges to SIP trunks or telephony carriers. The axis therefore applies. The evidence covers WebTransport, HLS/CMAF, ffmpeg/OBS/GStreamer ingest, WebRTC players and clustering, but never mentions SIP, PSTN or any telephony provider interoperability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
